prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [141].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 141 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: The delivery date can be used to close the case if both headsets have the same model number.
options.zh: 如果兩副耳機型號相同，就可以用送達日期結案。
options.whyZh: 同款型號不能代替單件序號；收到且比對原耳機是兩個必要條件。

options.text: Leave the case open if the carrier confirms delivery but inventory has not matched the number.
options.zh: 若承運人確認已送達，但庫存管理人員還沒核對序號，請不要結案。
options.whyZh: 送達只符合其中一個條件；序號未比對仍不結案。否則可能在確認收到的是哪件之前就讓統計下降。

options.text: Wait for inventory to match the number before sending a replacement.
options.zh: 先等庫存管理人員比對序號再寄替換品。
options.whyZh: 前文允許替換品先送到；此段目的是規定何時結案，而非延後寄替換品。

options.text: Close the case as soon as delivery of the original appears on the carrier’s page.
options.zh: 只要承運人的頁面顯示原耳機已送達，就立即結案。
options.whyZh: 只確認送達仍缺少序號比對；下一句正是要避免這類過早結案。

explanationZh: 送達只符合其中一個條件；序號未比對仍不結案。否則可能在確認收到的是哪件之前就讓統計下降。
evidence: We close it only after the original is received and its serial number is matched to the case. / Otherwise, the count would drop before we could confirm what came back. / The carrier may already have delivered it even if inventory has not yet matched the serial number.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We close it only after the original is received and its serial number is matched to the case.
Otherwise, the count would drop before we could confirm what came back.
The carrier may already have delivered it even if inventory has not yet matched the serial number.

vocabulary.note: match 除了「配對」也指核對這個序號對應哪一筆案件。
